metaAudit.rationale: Independent raw/high-resolution review found no available carrier, meaning change, or material relation omitted by the protocol. Speech, exact raw SRT, burned captions, UI/OCR, pointer state, filmed-monitor context, editing order, non-speech audio, visible identity/model strings, qualifiers, counts, and bounded absences are guarded. The protocol explicitly challenges identity inversion, literal result signatures, opening/closing scope, edited chronology, TTS playback, hidden operational bridges, scoped negative evidence, technical segmentation, and cartoon causality. Bare OCR aliases resolve to the standard OCR artifact; overlapping high-resolution OCR IDs are explicitly namespaced as ocr-highres.json#OCR-xxxxx.
